> 第十章 诬陷 二（第1页）
“可是姐姐……”蓝汐冷委屈的还想说什么。
“你别说了，我相信紫茉，我相信她不会那么做。爹那里，我去解释，不就是一个镯子吗？下次见了爹，我就说王爷见这镯子成色好，要去送给沐贵妃了。”说完，便拉着紫茉回房。
“等等，”紫茉拉住蓝若晴站住脚步，“小姐，既然相信我是清白的，那让二小姐搜一下又何妨呢？”
还没等蓝若晴说话，蓝汐冷便跑进房间，“那我来搜。”
不知道为什么，蓝若晴的心突然之间变得忐忑不安，似乎偷东西的人是她，即将被人发现似的。紧紧的抓住紫茉的手，随众婢女一起回到蓝若晴的房间。
里间是蓝若晴的卧室，平日里云王皇甫陌轩不在时，蓝若晴都与紫茉住在一起。外间，是紫茉的，很简单的一张床，一个放衣服的柜子。
比其他婢女多的是，紫茉有一个独立的梳妆台，那是蓝若晴在娘家的陪嫁。
蓝若晴喜欢这个梳妆台，于是嫁过来的时候一并带过来。
云王府里家具多的是，而且为了云王大婚，全部重新订做的。
云王不喜欢这个梳妆台，说是太旧了，放在新房不合适，所以这个梳妆台就给了紫茉。
“怎样？我就说嘛，紫茉这里不会有的。”蓝若晴的心终于放下，对着蓝汐冷说。可是显然有些底气不够足。
蓝汐冷看向那个梳妆台，“姐姐，这里还有个梳妆台呢。看看，这里还落着锁。”
这个锁，还是蓝若晴在家里时就有的，因为蓝若晴总是爱弄丢东西。紫茉说，安把锁头，把小姐的首饰都放在里面，这样就不会丢了。谁知，今日这把小小的锁头却让蓝汐冷起疑了。
紫茉上前，拿出腰间的钥匙，轻轻的打开锁头。
蓝汐冷大力的拉开抽屉，一只翠绿的镯子躺在几只廉价的首饰中间。
“找到了，找到了！”蓝汐冷高兴的拿出镯子戴在手上，轻轻抚摸着。像抚摸着丢失已久的孩子。
钥匙在自己的身上，没有离开过，这个抽屉平常都不会打开的。
平日里小姐不怎么佩戴饰品，天长日久的，紫茉也养成了不佩戴饰品的习惯。

“发生了什么事？”随着一声暴喝，走进一个人。“怎么都在这里站着？院子里也没有人，都做什么呢？”
蓝若晴回身一看，原来是云王皇甫陌轩，不由得心凉半截。
他怎么会在这个时候来的？昨天晚上派人和他说，蓝汐冷要住在这里，让云王不必过来。谁知这一大清早的，云王就跑来这。这个时候他来了，事情就不好办了，即使是小事，也会变大。而且皇甫陌轩对紫茉印象不好，曾经要撵紫茉出门，现在这个情况，该怎样处理？
皇甫陌轩走到蓝若晴身边，问道：“若晴，怎么回事？下人们都跑到主母卧室里来，这成什么规矩？”
一时间，蓝若晴不知该怎样和他说。这个事实，她自己都没有接受呢，怎么能和他解释清楚呢？

> Chapter 10 Framed 2 (Page 1)
"But sister..." Lan tide was aggrieved and wanted to say something else.
"Stop talking, I believe Zimo, I believe she won't do that. I'll go and explain to dad, isn't it just a bracelet? Next time I see dad, I will tell him that the prince saw that the bracelet is of good quality and is going to give it to Concubine Mu." After that, he took Zima back to the room.
"Wait a minute," Zimo pulled Lan Ruoqing to stop, "Miss, since you believe that I am innocent, why not let the second lady search me?"
Before Lan Ruoqing could say anything, Lan Xileng ran into the room, "Then I'll search."
For some reason, Lan Ruoqing suddenly felt uneasy, as if she was the one who stole the thing and was about to be discovered. Holding Zi Mo's hand tightly, she followed the maids back to Lan Ruoqing's room.
The inner room is Lan Ruoqing's bedroom. On weekdays, when King Yun Huangfu Moxuan is away, Lan Ruoqing lives with Zimo. The outer room belongs to Zimo, with a very simple bed and a cabinet for clothes.
Compared with other maids, Zimo has an independent dressing table, which was Lan Ruoqing's dowry from her natal family.
Lan Ruoqing liked this dressing table, so she brought it with her when she got married.
There are a lot of furniture in Prince Yun's Mansion, and all of them were custom-made for Prince Yun's wedding.
King Yun didn't like the dressing table, saying it was too old and not suitable for a new house, so he gave the dressing table to Zi Mo.
"What? I'm just telling you, there won't be anything here in Zimo." Lan Ruoqing finally let go and said to Lan tide Leng. But obviously some confidence is not enough.
Lan Xi Leng looked at the dressing table, "Sister, there is another dressing table here. Look, there is still a lock here."
Lan Ruoqing had this lock when she was at home, because Lan Ruoqing always loved to lose things. Zi Mo said, put the lock and put all the lady's jewelry inside so that they won't be lost. Who would have thought that this little lock would make Lan tide Leng suspicious today.
Zimo stepped forward, took out the key from her waist, and gently opened the lock.
Lan tide Leng opened the drawer vigorously, and found an emerald green bracelet lying among several cheap jewelry.
"Found it, found it!" Lan tide Leng happily took out the bracelet and put it on her hand, stroking it gently. Like caressing a long lost child.
The key is with me and has never been taken away. This drawer is usually never opened.
On weekdays, young ladies don't wear much jewelry. Over time, Zimo also developed the habit of not wearing jewelry.
"What happened?" Following a loud shout, a person walked in. "Why are you standing here? There is no one in the yard, what are you doing?"
Lan Ruoqing turned around and saw that it was Prince Yun Huangfu Moxuan, and couldn't help but feel a chill in her heart.
How could he come at this time? Someone was sent to him last night to tell him that Lan Xileng wanted to live here so that King Yun didn't have to come over. Unexpectedly, King Yun would come here so early in the morning. When he comes at this time, things will be difficult to handle. Even small things will become bigger. Moreover, Huangfu Moxuan had a bad impression of Zima. He once wanted to kick Zima out. How should he deal with this situation now?
Huangfu Moxuan walked up to Lan Ruoqing and asked, "Ruoqing, what's going on? The servants all ran to the mistress's bedroom. What's the rule?"
For a moment, Lan Ruoqing didn't know what to say to him. She hadn't accepted this fact herself, so how could she explain it to him?
